data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1969 reported a net profit of $10.7m on the development of the 2017 and prior years of account during 2020, indicating a release of reserves. This favorable development was primarily driven by a split reinsurance to close (RITC) of liabilities from 2017 and prior years to a newly formed legacy Syndicate 1994, which generated a saving against carried reserves. The 2018 year of account closed at a loss, reflecting large natural catastrophe events from that year, but the 2019 catastrophe estimates remained stable. The syndicate also experienced significant losses in 2020 from an unusually active North Atlantic wind season, including Hurricanes Sally and Laura, and the Midwest Derecho event, totaling $23.4m net. COVID-19 related losses added a net cost of $13.6m.
